name: goblin-util
description: Two mods for the machine you run Claude Code on: /pain logs friction with the tool itself without a turn, and /fleet shows every session on the machine and lets you message one.

enabled.title: Util on
enabled.description: The one switch for all of it. Off, the heartbeat stops, /pain and /fleet are not registered and nothing is written to the shared store.

heartbeat_seconds.title: Fleet heartbeat
heartbeat_seconds.description: How often this session writes its row to the shared store, in seconds.

stale_minutes.title: Fleet forgets after
stale_minutes.description: A session that has not written for this many minutes is dropped from the fleet.
